subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Must this provider-backed hot-reload fix include redacted live WeChat A+B QR-login evidence before merge, or may the focused gateway lifecycle regressions be accepted as sufficient?
rationale: The contributor has resolved the prior mechanical findings but cannot produce the provider session from the available environment, and only a gateway owner can set the acceptable proof threshold for a change that can affect live multi-account delivery.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with an approved WeChat setup provides redacted after-fix A+B reload evidence.

options.title: Accept focused gateway proof
options.body: Explicitly waive live-provider proof and accept the current lifecycle regressions, typecheck, lint, and build evidence for this narrowly guarded handoff.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with an approved WeChat setup provides redacted after-fix A+B reload evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on account-aware gateway reload planning makes them the strongest evidence-backed routing candidate available in this review context.
